# faBolus — LLM guide

> A pump-agnostic remote-bolus + status app for Tandem t:slim X2. The iPhone owns the pump's
> Bluetooth link (via sibling `TandemKit`). On `main` the remotes are the Garmin watch app and
> the Quick-Bolus widget: each takes one explicit human confirmation, then relays the dose to the
> host phone, which recomputes and clamps it before delivering. The Mac menu-bar and
> iPhone-peer remote clients are off `main` (BRANCHES.md §1.2c). Experimental, not FDA-cleared.

## Start with
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — commands, how-to-add-X, safety, gotchas.
- [BRANCHES.md](BRANCHES.md) — branch model and experimental gate.
- [docs/glossary.md](docs/glossary.md) — terms.

## Safety (never violate)
- Insulin-affecting commands: UI confirm/hold → backend clamp (`Interlocks.absoluteMaxUnits` = 25 U,
  ≥ 0.05 U) → `WritePolicy` (default `.readOnly`) → signed `modifiesInsulinDelivery` message,
  byte-verified against the TandemKit oracle.
- Stale glucose (> ~6 min, `GlucoseFreshness`) is marked, never current, never auto-fills a correction.
- Gating is `AccessPolicy` via `AppModel.allow` / `accessDecision` — one chokepoint.

## Layout
- `Packages/faBolusCore/` — `PumpBackend`, `GlucoseSource` / `GlucoseArbiter`, `RemoteCommand`,
  `AccessPolicy`, the `RemoteTransport` protocol, models.
- `ios/faBolus/Data/` — `AppModel`, `TandemBackend`, `MockBackend`, `GarminRemoteBridge`, `AppSettings`.
- `ios/faBolus/Views/` — SwiftUI. Display views take plain values.
- `Shared/` — widget store and shared snapshot types.
- `ios/faBolusWidgets/` — Lock/Home Screen widgets.
- `schema/command.schema.json` — phone↔remote contract (source of truth).
- `hosts/loop/` — unbuilt sketch.

No `watch/` tree on `main`. Garmin lives in `../faBolusGarmin`. Pump bytes live in `../TandemKit`.

## Commands
- Core tests: `swift test --package-path Packages/faBolusCore`
- Simulator: `./scripts/build-sim.sh`
- Schema: `scripts/check-schema-drift.sh`

## Conventions
Match surrounding style. Don't invent pump behavior; unverified fields go in
`docs/UNVERIFIED-GUESSES.md`.
